vo: The easiest way to practice along with the songs you love.

scenes.title: Drop in a song
scenes.sub: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF or FLAC — straight from your Mac.
vo: Just drag in a song you have the rights to use,

scenes.title: Split right on your Mac
scenes.sub: Demucs runs on your GPU. No music ever leaves your computer.
vo: The AI splits it right on your Mac.
and you can follow every step{done} of the way.

scenes.title: Vocals, drums, bass and other
scenes.sub: Every part gets its own lane — the whole song at a glance.
vo: each get their own lane, in their own color.

scenes.title: Solo, mute and volume
scenes.sub: Hear just the drums — or drop the vocals and sing the part yourself.
vo: Want to hear just the drums?

scenes.title: Tempo and pitch
scenes.sub: Slow down without changing the key. Change the key without changing the tempo.
vo: {pitch}Or shift the key, to fit your voice.

scenes.title: A click that follows the song
scenes.sub: Tempo and downbeats are found in the drums — the click keeps up at any speed.
vo: {bpm}StemSplitter finds the tempo in the drums.
and it lands right on the beat, at any speed.

scenes.title: Save your mix, pick up where you left off
scenes.sub: Export your own mix as WAV. Earlier songs open instantly.
vo: Save your own mix{export} as an audio file,
and jump back into earlier songs,{library} in one click.
